aboutGame.title: What is MapleStory Classic World?
paragraphs: MapleStory Classic World is Nexon's classic pre-Big Bang MMORPG service, rebuilt around the systems that defined early MapleStory: slow leveling, manual job advancements at fixed levels, scroll-based gear upgrades, party quests, and a player-run Free Market. It is officially playable through the Nexon Launcher and Steam, with Founder's Access opening on October 6, 2026 and full launch on October 21, 2026.

The result is a deliberately social game where clear speed, map density, and survivability decide how fast you level, and where Clerics, Bishops, and Dark Knights stay in demand for their party buffs. Our wiki covers every system — classes, stats, ability points, training maps, boss preparation, mesos, and items — with practical guides built for the classic grind.

items.question: What is MapleStory Classic World?
items.answer: MapleStory Classic World is a classic pre-Big Bang MMORPG service from Nexon. It restores the original Explorer job branches, manual job advancements, scroll-based gear upgrades, party quests, and a player-run Free Market.

items.question: When does MapleStory Classic World release?
items.answer: Founder's Access opened on October 6, 2026, and the official MapleStory Classic World launch is scheduled for October 21, 2026 on the Nexon Launcher and Steam.

items.question: Which class should I pick in MapleStory Classic World?
items.answer: Bishop, Night Lord, and Hero sit at the top of the community tier list for party value and bossing, while Warrior and Magician are the smoothest picks for a first character in MapleStory Classic World.

items.question: How long does leveling take in MapleStory Classic World?
items.answer: Leveling in MapleStory Classic World is deliberately slow. Clear speed, map density, and survivability decide your EXP per hour, so progress is measured in hours per level rather than minutes.

items.question: Does MapleStory Classic World have a Founder's Pack?
items.answer: Yes. MapleStory Classic World Founder's Packs are sold in Standard, Deluxe, and Collector tiers around launch and typically include head-start access, cosmetics, a pet, inventory slots, and name reservation.
